title: FTP connection and automation
description: Standby MCP tasks use the server connection. Leave Operation empty for those tasks. Set it when starting a normal run, an API run, or a Schedule.

protocol.title: Protocol
protocol.sectionDescription: Used by Standby MCP and by backup, sync, and compare.

host.title: Server hostname
host.description: Hostname or IP address, without a URL or path.

username.title: Username
username.description: Username for the remote file server.

password.title: Password
password.description: Password for the remote file server, if used.

privateKey.title: SSH private key
privateKey.description: Optional SFTP private key in PEM or OpenSSH format.

passphrase.title: SSH key passphrase
passphrase.description: Passphrase for the SSH private key, if encrypted.

hostKeySha256.title: SFTP host key fingerprint
hostKeySha256.description: Required for SFTP. The server's trusted SHA256 fingerprint, for example SHA256:... Obtain it from your server administrator.

operation.title: Operation
enumTitles: Sync a remote directory and a snapshot
operation.description: Leave empty for a Standby MCP task. Set this to run one job from the Console, the API, or a Schedule.
operation.sectionDescription: Ignored while the Actor is running in Standby. A scheduled or manual run uses these fields and then exits.

remotePath.title: Remote directory
remotePath.description: Directory to back up, sync, or compare. Defaults to /.

include.title: Include globs
include.description: Only consider files matching at least one pattern. Empty includes every file. A pattern without a slash matches the file name in any directory. ** crosses directories.

exclude.title: Exclude globs
exclude.description: Skip files matching any of these patterns. Exclude is applied before include.

direction.title: Sync direction
direction.description: Sync only. remote-to-store copies the server into the snapshot. store-to-remote copies a snapshot onto the server.

dryRun.title: Dry run
dryRun.description: Sync only. Report what would change and do not copy or delete anything.

deleteExtraneous.title: Delete extraneous files
deleteExtraneous.description: Sync only. Delete destination files that are not in the source. Off by default. A backup always replaces its named snapshot and does not delete remote files.

snapshotName.title: Snapshot name
snapshotName.description: Name of the snapshot in the key-value store. 1-40 characters: letters, numbers, and !-_.'(). Use a new name to keep an older backup.

keyValueStoreId.title: Key-value store
keyValueStoreId.description: Store id or name for the snapshot. Leave empty to use this run's default key-value store.

maxFileBytes.title: Maximum file size (bytes)
maxFileBytes.description: Files larger than this fail the job with an error before they are stored. Default and hard cap: 100 MiB (104857600). Files are streamed one at a time.

baseline.title: Compare against
baseline.description: Compare only. A snapshot is a backup already stored under Snapshot name.
baseline.sectionDescription: Used when Operation is compare. Added, changed, and removed paths are written to the run dataset.

compareRemotePath.title: Directory on the second server
compareRemotePath.description: Remote directory for the second server. Leave empty to use the same directory as Remote directory.

compareProtocol.title: Second server protocol
compareProtocol.description: Required when Compare against is a second server.

compareHost.title: Second server hostname
compareHost.description: Hostname or IP address of the second server.

comparePassword.title: Second server password
comparePassword.description: Password for the second server, if used.

comparePrivateKey.title: Second server SSH private key
comparePrivateKey.description: Optional SFTP private key for the second server.

comparePassphrase.title: Second server SSH key passphrase
comparePassphrase.description: Passphrase for the second server's private key, if encrypted.

compareHostKeySha256.title: Second server SFTP fingerprint
compareHostKeySha256.description: Required when the second server uses SFTP. SHA256 host key fingerprint.
